items.why_it_matters: A SEBI letter to ICICI Securities could carry regulatory action; the contents are not disclosed, so watch for follow-up detail.

items.title: Anthropic's debut rally fades as shares crack 7% in US pre-market trade
items.snippet: Anthropic shares fell as much as 7.4% in premarket trading on their second day, as a global market selloff and concerns over the AI trade overshadowed the optimism surrounding its record-setting IPO debut. After surging 39% from the IPO price on Thursday, the stock ended 17% higher. A steep…
items.why_it_matters: Global AI-trade selloff and weak US pre-market tone could weigh on sentiment at the open, especially in IT and tech-linked flows.

items.title: US Dollar: Hawkish Fed risks and safe-haven demand support USD – OCBC
items.why_it_matters: Hawkish Fed risk supports the dollar and could pressure emerging-market flows and the rupee at the open.

items.title: Sebi digitises FPI onboarding, aims to cut registration time to five business days: Chairman
items.why_it_matters: Faster FPI onboarding supports foreign inflows; impact on prices is incremental and gradual rather than immediate.

items.title: SEBI eyes faster FPI onboarding, plans fresh reforms to attract foreign capital

items.why_it_matters: Consultation paper on further FPI relaxations is a pending policy step; watch for its release timing.

items.title: SEBI plans further easing of FPI rules to attract foreign capital; consultation paper soon
items.snippet: The proposed changes seek to reduce regulatory hurdles for overseas investors as India looks to deepen participation in its capital markets
items.why_it_matters: SEBI consultation on easing FPI rules is a proposal only; watch for foreign flow sentiment but no immediate trigger.

items.title: Crude oil futures gain on reports of Houthi attack in Riyadh
items.snippet: January Brent oil futures were at $92.44, up by 0.50%, and January crude oil futures on WTI (West Texas Intermediate) were at $82.90, up by 0.56%
items.why_it_matters: Brent near $92 with Middle East attack reports raises input-cost risk for India. Watch for crude spikes that hit OMCs and the rupee.

items.snippet: Kristalina Georgieva, the head of the International Monetary Fund, has voiced her concerns regarding the overzealous excitement surrounding artificial intelligence. She foresees further corrections in AI-driven financial markets, as the Nasdaq 100 index has seen notable declines, causing…
items.why_it_matters: IMF warning of further AI-led correction adds to global risk-off sentiment. Watch overnight US tech moves.
